name: FST
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过弹性或隔振支承将轨道板与基础相隔离的轨道结构。
usage_overview: 通过板下弹性支承实现隔振，用于车辆—轨道及其与下部结构耦合系统的减振分析和现场验证。研究可考察轨道板位移等响应；离散支承或点弹簧是其中的支承布置或建模方式。

complete_examples.text: Among different measures, FST has been proven to be the most effective.
In this paper, the point-supporting rubber bearing FST is taken as the research object.
The FST system, as a kind of ballastless track system, is widely applied in the urban vibration-attenuation track system.
Firstly, the frequency response function (receptance) is introduced to analyze the characteristics of the FST at the frequency domain.
